reviews.text: For some reason they changed this from a useful app where you could easily morph faces into an AI baby photo collage maker. Was once the most easy and available ways to neutrally morph faces. It does not even resemble the original. Terrible update eliminating the purpose of the app.

reviews.title: End result is blurry
reviews.text: Fun features, really useful element lets you map out the facial features accurately, but the problem is that the end result is blurry and virtually useless. It doesn’t blend the features so much as just superimpose them on one another.
